decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product line that had dedicated web presentation and survived the firm's early post-launch review while weaker launches were already removed, it likely meets aspiration levels and still fits the modular system portfolio.

Although it had lower prominence than A and E, it is closely related to the established formwork business and is likely retained because its modest resource demands and complementarity to system sales justify carrying it above a minimum aspiration threshold.

This product had a dedicated page and strong strategic fit with the firm's tailored formwork offering, so a medium-sized German machinery firm with in-house R&D would likely continue it unless results clearly fell short, which is not indicated here.

F is the most vulnerable of the surviving products because it was only mentioned rather than prominently featured, but its closeness to the core offer and possible role as a supporting component make retention more likely than withdrawal.
